mapper.sql: id AS inbox_message_id, message_id, account_id, notification_code AS code, language_tag, title, text_content AS text, html_content AS html, created_at, read_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_inbox_message WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_inbox_message (id, message_id, account_id, notification_code, language_tag, title, text_content, html_content) VALUES (#{inboxMessageId}, #{messageId}, #{accountId}, #{notificationCode}, #{languageTag}, #{title}, #{text}, #{html}) ON CONFLICT (message_id, account_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_inbox_message SET read_at = #{readAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
